batches.review_scope: Exhaustive section/paragraph completeness checks; targeted bilingual editorial comparison of arguments, evidence boundaries, conclusions and natural phrasing. Not an independent line-by-line historical certification of all twenty texts.
notes: Chinese and English pages, including the shared Traditional Chinese reading path, remain byte-for-byte unchanged in this batch.
Preserve the supplied distinctions between reports, conjectures and established facts in the 1934 refereeing/Sindelar passages, Brazil's racialized scapegoating and the 1954 doping controversy.
EP01 five-language manuscripts describe two months as travel plus tournament absence; Chinese says sea travel. This supplied clarification is retained and disclosed, not silently applied to Chinese.
Short standalone titles and translated decks avoid duplicating episode numbers already in the page shell. Bodies retain every source paragraph.
EP12 and EP16 source corrections agreed with the author are reserved for their respective later batches.
